title: SWING11_S1B_INFERENCE_ADVANCEMENT_SPEC_V1_SUPPLEMENT_1 — prospective canonical clarification
decision:
PROSPECTIVE SUPPLEMENT; NO SWING11 SCIENTIFIC OUTCOMES HAVE BEEN COMPUTED OR INSPECTED.

This supplement resolves only the three specification blockers identified by MWE-SW11-S2A-001 and leaves the original S1 decisions unchanged.

A. SCIENTIFIC COORDINATES AND MATCHED ELIGIBILITY
For each mechanism M and horizon H, use centered same-date average-percentile ranks for both PRICE and M in all scientific cross-sectional regressions. Raw mechanism values remain semantic/audit diagnostics and are not substituted into the primary regressions. Ranking is performed separately on the finite predictor-eligible same-date cross section before response/end-point eligibility is applied. The scientific matched sample for a mechanism/horizon/date is then the intersection of symbols with finite PRICE rank, finite M rank, finite adjusted close_t and finite adjusted close at the registered endpoint t+H. Baseline, adjusted and conditioning models for that mechanism/horizon/date MUST use this identical matched symbol set. Require N>=4, full column rank and the already-certified SVD identification rule; otherwise the date estimator is unavailable.
Forward Return_H = adjusted_close(t+H)/adjusted_close(t)-1 using the registered trading-session calendar, exactly H sessions forward from decision date t. No open-price, intraday, overlapping-capital or execution interpretation is implied. No imputation, alternate endpoint, delisting substitution or result-based exclusion.

B. BASELINE PRICE AND INTERACTION INFERENCE
For each H, baseline date series b0_t is the PRICE coefficient from Return_H ~ 1 + PRICE_rank on the applicable registered matched baseline case. Primary baseline null H0:E[b0_t]=0, two-sided. Required scientific direction for baseline PRICE is NEGATIVE. Interaction date series g_t is the PRICE_rank*M_rank coefficient from Return_H ~ 1+PRICE_rank+M_rank+PRICE_rank*M_rank on the exact matched mechanism/H sample. Interaction null H0:E[g_t]=0, two-sided. Interaction has NO prospectively required sign; positive or negative interactions can be scientifically meaningful if all other gates pass. Standardized effect for baseline/interaction = mean(date series)/sampleSD(date series), ddof1. HAC/Newey-West Bartlett lag H-1 on the date series; raw p=2*(1-Phi(abs(mean/HAC_SE))). Nonfinite/zero HAC SE or fewer than max(20,H+2) finite date estimates => NOT_TESTABLE for that registered test.

C. 48-TEST PRICE ATTENUATION ESTIMAND AND INFERENCE
On each matched mechanism/H/date t, estimate baseline PRICE coefficient b0_t from Return~1+PRICE_rank and adjusted PRICE coefficient b1_t from Return~1+PRICE_rank+M_rank using the identical matched symbols. Define paired attenuation-difference date series d_t = s_H*(b0_t-b1_t), where s_H = sign(mean(b0_t)) determined from the complete preregistered baseline date series for H before inspecting mechanism-specific d_t; if mean(b0_t)=0 or nonfinite, all attenuation tests at H are NOT_TESTABLE. Under the frozen required baseline direction NEGATIVE, s_H is expected -1, making positive d_t mean shrinkage of PRICE magnitude toward zero. Primary attenuation null H0:E[d_t]=0, two-sided; scientific support requires mean(d_t)>0. HAC/Newey-West Bartlett lag H-1 on d_t. raw p=2*(1-Phi(abs(mean(d_t)/HAC_SE_d))). Standardized attenuation effect ES_d=mean(d_t)/sampleSD(d_t), ddof1, and materiality requires ES_d>=0.20. If sample SD or HAC SE is nonfinite/<=1e-12, or finite paired date count <max(20,H+2), test is NOT_TESTABLE.
Descriptive aggregate attenuation remains ATTEN=1-|mean(b1_t)|/|mean(b0_t)| on the identical paired dates. If |mean(b0_t)|<=1e-12 or nonfinite, attenuation is NOT_TESTABLE. Material explanatory attenuation additionally requires ATTEN>=0.25. ATTEN 0.10-<0.25 is weak/modest diagnostic evidence only; ATTEN<0.10 is negligible; ATTEN<0 is counterevidence. The inferential test is the paired d_t test, not a nonlinear per-date ratio and not a ratio-of-aggregate-coefficients test.

D. MULTIPLICITY AND MATERIALITY
Preserve exactly the frozen BH families: baseline PRICE 8; attenuation 48; interactions 48; q<=0.05 separately. Unavailable tests retain p=1 bookkeeping slots and do not shrink a family. Baseline/attenuation required sign is negative PRICE / positive attenuation respectively. Interaction sign is unrestricted but must be nonzero in the direction of its observed preregistered coefficient and pass two-sided FDR/materiality. Materiality: baseline abs(ES)>=0.20; attenuation ES_d>=0.20 plus ATTEN>=0.25; interaction abs(ES)>=0.20.

E. ROBUSTNESS
Use four chronological blocks fixed from predictor/end-point eligibility before outcomes. Baseline requires negative block mean in >=3/4 available blocks; attenuation requires positive mean d_t and positive descriptive ATTEN in >=3/4; interaction requires >=3/4 block means with the same sign as the full-sample interaction. For every applicable case max absolute block contribution abs(block_mean*block_N)/sum(abs(block_mean*block_N)) <=0.50; denominator zero => fail robustness. Missing required block diagnostic fails robustness, not primary testability unless the primary estimator itself is unavailable.
Symbol concentration uses the already-frozen additive-contribution accounting, top1/5/10 shares and HHI, followed by deterministic top-five absolute-contributor removal and complete estimator refit on the remaining symbols while preserving original predictor ranks. Concentration passes only if leave-five retains the required full-sample direction and absolute standardized effect attenuation is <=75%; for attenuation also ATTEN remains >0; for interaction the sign must not reverse. Primary inference never drops contributors.
Adjacency/horizon coherence is evaluated within each mechanism and evidence type over ordered horizons 1,2,3,5,7,10,15,20. A horizon is adjacency-supported only when it and at least one immediate registered neighbor both pass that evidence type's primary direction/FDR/materiality gates. Endpoint horizons therefore require their sole immediate neighbor. Robustness is assessed on the focal horizon separately.

F. DETERMINISTIC DISPOSITION TRUTH TABLE AND PRECEDENCE
Precedence is NOT_TESTABLE > COUNTEREVIDENCE > CONDITIONING_SUPPORTED > EXPLANATORY_EVIDENCE > MECHANISM_SUPPORTED.
Evaluate each mechanism across all eight horizons, retaining horizon-level gate results.
NOT_TESTABLE: no testable baseline/adjusted/interaction scientific path exists for the mechanism because required estimators/eligibility are unavailable across all horizons; individual unavailable horizons remain NOT_TESTABLE rows but do not force mechanism-level NOT_TESTABLE when other horizons are testable.
COUNTEREVIDENCE: mechanism-level disposition when testable evidence exists but none qualifies below AND either (i) at least two adjacent attenuation horizons have ATTEN<0 with the attenuation paired mean d_t<=0, or (ii) every testable horizon fails all FDR gates for both attenuation and interaction. Otherwise absence of qualifying evidence is reported as COUNTEREVIDENCE with reason INSUFFICIENT_REGISTERED_SUPPORT; this label is not evidence of an opposite causal effect.
CONDITIONING_SUPPORTED: at least two adjacent interaction horizons each pass interaction FDR, abs(ES)>=0.20, temporal robustness and concentration robustness, with the same interaction sign across the adjacent pair. This takes precedence over explanatory evidence because conditioning changes the PRICE relationship rather than merely attenuating it.
EXPLANATORY_EVIDENCE: at least two adjacent attenuation horizons each pass positive d_t direction, attenuation-family FDR, ES_d>=0.20, ATTEN>=0.25, temporal robustness and concentration robustness. Baseline PRICE at those horizons must itself be negative and pass its baseline FDR/materiality gate.
MECHANISM_SUPPORTED: reserved for reproducible but weaker mechanism evidence: at least two adjacent horizons show either (a) attenuation-family FDR with positive d_t and ES_d>=0.20 but ATTEN in [0.10,0.25), OR (b) interaction-family FDR/materiality with same-sign adjacency but one required robustness gate fails. This category cannot authorize use of the failed robustness aspect in S3; only the supported descriptive/mechanistic aspect may be carried forward.
If both CONDITIONING_SUPPORTED and EXPLANATORY_EVIDENCE qualify, disposition is CONDITIONING_SUPPORTED and the explanatory result is retained as a secondary supported aspect. If stronger categories do not qualify but MECHANISM_SUPPORTED does, use MECHANISM_SUPPORTED. Otherwise COUNTEREVIDENCE.

G. S2/S3 BOUNDARY
S2-B remains separately authorized scientific execution after S2-A certification completes. S3 entry still requires at least one MECHANISM_SUPPORTED, CONDITIONING_SUPPORTED or EXPLANATORY_EVIDENCE mechanism. Only aspects that passed their own frozen gates may be used in S3. No protected validation sample is opened by this supplement.
evidence: MWE-SW11-S2A-001 verified blocker; no SWING11 scientific outcomes computed/read before this supplement.
rationale: Prospectively complete the inferential estimand, scientific coordinates, robustness gates and deterministic disposition mapping identified as undefined by the verified outcome-blind S2-A preflight.
